newsitem.title: CANADA: Band-Ore reports Timmins gold drilling.
newsitem.headline: Band-Ore reports Timmins gold drilling.

text.p: Band-Ore Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that a step-out drill hole on its Timmins gold property has intersected ore-grade gold mineralization.
The hole assayed 0.153 ounces of gold per tonne over 11.5 feet.
The company also said it has discovered an outcrop which contains similar mineralization and alteration to its Golden River Zone.

Other drilling to the east and to the west of the zone has also intersected mineralization and alteration, extending the drill indicated strike length of the zone to about 1.6 kilometres, the company said in a statement.
The latest results from the ongoing drill program show gold ranging from 0.10 ounces per tonne to 0.72 ounces per tonne over widths ranging from 4.3 feet to 21.7 feet.
